edges.label: May 2026 On Watch interview restating the concealment allegation
edges.note: Interviewed by Chris Farrell for Judicial Watch's On Watch on 5 May 2026, restating that elements of the US government thwarted congressional oversight, withheld information from proper executive branch officials, and illegally concealed recovery and reverse-engineering programs. It is the immediate precursor to the June 2026 Capitol press conference.
